text: javadoc for PaymentReconciliationService, reviewer flagged missing @throws on reconcileBatch
XCTest for WorkoutSessionViewModel pause/resume, elapsed time shouldn't drift
replace unwrap()s in src/parser/ledger.rs with proper Result and thiserror
bubbletea fleet list: highlight offline trucks red, add a status column
goroutine leak in telemetry ingest worker when device disconnects mid-batch, see internal/ingest/worker.go
check app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts verifies signature before parsing body
add --dry-run to scripts/reconcile_payouts.py, print the diff instead of writing rows
room migration v7→v8: split workouts.duration into active_seconds and rest_seconds

Front desk staff at the clinics keep asking for recurring appointments, like every Tuesday at 10 for six weeks. Can you add a recurrence option to the Appointment model in scheduling/models.py and have AppointmentCreateView generate the individual slots? It should skip any date where the provider already has a ProviderTimeOff entry.

Patients are getting their refill reminder SMS twice on the Sunday clocks change. The Celery beat job in `reminders/tasks.py::send_due_refill_reminders` compares naive datetimes against `Prescription.next_refill_at`, which is stored in UTC. Can you fix the comparison so each reminder fires exactly once across DST transitions?

Our fleet telemetry service in `cmd/anomaly` computes a rolling z-score on engine temperature per truck, but it fires way too many false alarms on cold starts. Can you swap it for an isolation-forest style detector (go-isoforest or a small hand-rolled one is fine) and train it on the last 30 days from `testdata/telemetry.csv`?

Our banking app's `TransferViewModel` calls Retrofit and the Room DAO directly and handles the caching itself. Could you move that into a `TransferRepository` injected with Hilt, so the ViewModel only deals with UI state and the Compose screen stays the same?

We're splitting the leaderboard from one global table into per-season tables. Can you write a Go migration command under cmd/migrate-leaderboard that copies rows from `leaderboard_entries` into `leaderboard_s{N}` based on the season_id, recomputes rank within each season, and verifies the per-season counts at the end?

The sensor readings page in our greenhouse controller (`web/views/readings.templ`, served with htmx) is just a long table right now. Could you turn it into a grid of tiles per zone showing temperature, humidity and last-updated time, with stale readings visibly greyed out?

Our GitHub Actions CI for the claims-processing service takes 14 minutes, and most of that is reinstalling poetry deps on every run. Can you add dependency caching keyed on poetry.lock to ci.yml and split pytest into the unit and integration jobs we already mark with @pytest.mark.integration?

Can you set up a release for our Axum-based game matchmaking server so that tagging a version builds a distroless image with cargo-chef caching and pushes it to GHCR? Right now every deploy rebuilds all deps from scratch and takes about 14 minutes.

Add tappable push notifications for parcel status changes in the Android app (Kotlin, Compose).
- Handle FCM data messages in `ParcelMessagingService` with fields parcel_id, status, eta
- Show a notification on a new "Delivery updates" channel, with a user-toggleable setting in SettingsScreen
- Tapping opens TrackingDetailScreen for that parcel through a deep link `parceltrack://parcel/{id}`, wired into the Navigation Compose graph
- Request POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+ the first time the user tracks a parcel, not at startup
- Acceptance: works from cold start and when the app is in the background; add a unit test for the payload parsing

Set up staged releases for the tutoring-marketplace web app (Next.js 15, app router) on Cloudflare via OpenNext.
- Three environments: `preview` per PR, `staging` on merge to `main`, `production` on a `v*` tag
- Each environment gets its own `wrangler.toml` env block and KV namespace for session data
- Build once, deploy the same artifact to staging and prod (no rebuild on tag)
- Post the deployed URL as a PR comment for previews
- Fail the release if `pnpm build` emits any type errors
Acceptance: tagging `v1.4.0` deploys the exact build that was on staging, and rolling back is a single `wrangler rollback` command documented in `docs/releasing.md`.

Fix duplicate orders on checkout in the Next.js storefront.
- Symptom: support reports ~40 double charges last week; logs show two `POST /api/orders` calls within 200ms from the same session
- `app/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx` disables the button only after `await createPaymentIntent()` resolves, so fast double-clicks get through
- Disable the submit immediately on click and show the pending state via `useFormStatus`
- Server side: make `app/api/orders/route.ts` honor an `Idempotency-Key` header (generate one per checkout attempt on the client) and return the existing order on a repeat
- Store keys in the existing `idempotency_keys` table via Prisma with a 24h expiry
Acceptance: a Playwright test that double-clicks Pay creates exactly one order, and a repeated request with the same key returns 200 with the same order id.

New checkout summary sidebar for the Next.js storefront (`components/checkout/OrderSummary.tsx`).
- Sticky on desktop (>=1024px); on mobile it becomes a collapsible bar pinned above the pay button
- Show line items with thumbnails, a promo code input, subtotal, shipping, tax and total
- Promo errors render inline under the input, not as a toast
- Use our Tailwind tokens from `tailwind.config.ts`, no hardcoded hex values
- Totals must not shift layout when the promo applies (reserve the space)
- Acceptance: matches the Figma 'Checkout v3' spacing, passes axe in the Playwright a11y spec, no CLS warnings in Lighthouse

Add Flutter widget tests for the medication reminder screen (`lib/features/reminders/reminder_list_page.dart`).
- Render with a mocked `ReminderRepository` using mocktail.
- Cases: empty state message, list sorted by next dose time, swipe-to-dismiss marks a dose as taken, and a snooze dialog with 10/30/60 min options.
- Add golden tests for light and dark themes at the 375x812 size.
- Fake the clock with `package:clock` so the tests don't depend on wall time.
Acceptance: `flutter test test/features/reminders` passes on CI, and goldens are committed under `test/goldens/`.

Goal: add a shipment delay classifier to the logistics backend (Kotlin, Spring Boot 3, Gradle).
- New module `:delay-model` that loads an XGBoost4J model from S3 at startup (path from `delay.model.uri`)
- `DelayPredictor.predict(shipment: Shipment): DelayRisk` returning LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH with probability
- Feature extraction in `ShipmentFeatures.kt` must match the training notebook column order; add a unit test against `src/test/resources/golden_features.csv`
- Hot-reload the model when a new version lands without restarting the pod
- Micrometer timer `delay.predict.latency`
Acceptance: `./gradlew :delay-model:test` passes and prediction stays under 5ms p95 in the JMH benchmark.

Harden JWT validation in our matchmaking gRPC service.
File: internal/auth/interceptor.go (unary + streaming interceptors, golang-jwt/jwt v5).
Requirements:
- reject alg=none and any alg other than RS256 explicitly
- enforce exp, nbf, and iss="auth.playgrid.io" with at most 30s clock skew
- the public key comes from JWKS; make sure the key cache can't be poisoned by a kid header pointing elsewhere
- player ID must come from the token claims, not from request metadata
Acceptance: table-driven tests in interceptor_test.go covering expired, wrong alg, wrong issuer, and forged kid cases; go test ./... and go vet pass.

Goal: containerize the warehouse-slotting API (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy) for staging.
- Multi-stage Dockerfile: build wheels in a python:3.12-slim build stage, copy only the venv into the final image
- Run as a non-root user `slotting` and expose port 8080 via uvicorn with 4 workers
- Add a docker-compose.yml with the app, a PG 16 container and Redis for local dev
- Alembic migrations run as a separate one-shot compose service, not on app startup
- Final image must be under 250MB (it is currently 1.1GB)
Acceptance: `docker compose up` brings up a working /healthz, and `make image` produces a tagged image.
lms/exports/quiz_attempts.csv에서 학생별 최고 점수랑 평균 응시 횟수를 과목별로 집계하는 스크립트를 scripts/aggregate_quiz.py로 만들어 주세요. 같은 attempt_id가 중복으로 들어온 행이 꽤 있어서 그거 먼저 걸러내야 하고, 결과는 pandas로 처리해서 parquet으로 저장하면 됩니다.
`NotificationSender` 클래스에 SMS, 이메일, 푸시 분기가 if-else로 다 들어가 있는데, 채널별로 인터페이스 구현체로 나눠주세요. Spring에서 `List<NotificationChannel>`으로 주입받는 방식이면 좋겠어요.
React Native 앱 로그인 화면에 Face ID / 지문 로그인 추가해줘. react-native-keychain으로 refresh token 저장하고, 최초 로그인 성공 후에 생체인증 사용할지 물어보는 모달도 띄워줘.
Django 쪽 `bookings/templates/bookings/slot_picker.html`에서 예약 시간 선택 UI가 너무 촘촘해서 모바일에서 잘못 누르는 경우가 많다는 피드백이 왔어요. 시간 버튼을 오전/오후로 그룹 나누고 터치 영역을 최소 44px로 키워주세요.
중고거래 Flutter 앱에서 lib/screens/item_webview.dart가 webview_flutter로 판매자가 넣은 임의 URL을 열고, JavaScriptChannel로 토큰 가져오는 함수까지 노출하고 있어. 허용 도메인만 로드하도록 막고 채널 노출 범위 검토해줘.
Airflow 스케줄러를 2.9로 올리면서 staging 환경에 먼저 배포하고 싶은데, `deploy/airflow/values-staging.yaml`에 이미지 태그랑 `AIRFLOW__CORE__PARALLELISM` 값 정리해주고 DAG 동기화가 git-sync로 되게 바꿔줘. prod는 아직 건드리지 말아줘.
src/error.rs에 있는 ApiError enum 각 variant에 doc comment 달아주고, 어떤 HTTP status로 매핑되는지도 적어줘. axum IntoResponse 구현 쪽에도 설명 좀 넣어주고, 프론트 팀이 에러 코드 표 달라고 해서 docs/errors.md도 같이 만들어줘.
부동산 매물 가격 예측 API(`app/api/estimate/route.ts`)에서 호출하는 Python 모델 서버 응답이 가끔 NaN으로 와서 화면이 깨져요. Node 쪽에서 응답 검증 추가하고 NaN이면 fallback으로 지역 평균가 보여주게 해주세요.

Our e-prescription importer (PrescriptionXmlParser.java, Maven module rx-import) parses XML from pharmacy partners with a default DocumentBuilderFactory, so I suspect XXE. Plan before coding: list every XML parsing site in the module and the risk for each first, then wait for my go-ahead before disabling DTDs and external entities.

Write unit tests for `ingest/csv_normalizer.py` in our ad analytics repo, especially `normalize_row()` and the currency conversion fallback. Don't add any new dependencies. Stick to pytest and unittest.mock, which we already have, and parametrize instead of copy-pasting cases.

Replace the raw dict handling in `app/routers/grades.py` with Pydantic v2 models for submissions and grade updates. Keep it backward compatible: the mobile app reads these responses, so the JSON shape and field names must stay identical. Run the existing pytest suite before and after to confirm nothing changed.

We need per-tenant feature flags in the Ktor backend for the warehouse SaaS so we can turn on the new picking screen for a few customers first. Plan before coding: give me a short proposal covering storage, caching, how routes check a flag, and how admins toggle it, and wait for my OK before writing any Kotlin.

The payments reconciliation worker (`internal/recon`) needs to go to prod tomorrow. Plan before coding: write up in `deploy/RECON_ROLLOUT.md` what env vars, IAM permissions on the S3 bucket, and cron schedule changes are needed, let me review it, and only then update the Terraform in `infra/recon/` and the systemd unit.

The analytics query service leaks memory: RSS climbs about 200MB/hour in prod. I believe the `Arc<QueryCache>` in `src/cache/mod.rs` gets cloned into every spawned task and the eviction path in `evict_expired` never runs because the interval task is dropped. Plan before coding: write up the suspected ownership cycle and how you'll verify it with a test, then make the fix.

Port the gradient-boosted credit risk scorer from the Python notebook into `risk-engine/src/model.rs` so loan decisions don't round-trip to the Python service. Minimal diff please — reuse the existing `Features` struct and the tree JSON export we already have in `assets/gbm_trees.json`, and don't touch the HTTP layer.

Add OWASP dependency-check to the Maven build of our patient-records API and run it nightly in CI rather than on every PR, since it takes ~6 minutes. Security first: fail on CVSS >= 7, keep the NVD API key in a CI secret only, and add a suppression file with justifications rather than blanket ignores.
